fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Workspace.

fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: Server-stamped ACL: IAM user ids that may read the row.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer.

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Project.

fields.name: Number
fields.description: Scope version number within the project.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Scope version title.

fields.name: Summary
fields.description: Summary of the scope.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Scope status. One of: draft|locked|unlocked|superseded.

fields.name: PlanHours
fields.description: Total planned hours.

fields.name: LockedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who locked the scope.

fields.name: LockedAt
fields.description: When the scope was locked.

fields.name: UnlockedAt
fields.description: When the scope was unlocked.

fields.name: EngineJobId
fields.description: ItemId of the EngineJob that drafted it.

fields.name: Origin
fields.description: Empty for the Factory's own records; "live-product" when product.document documented the record from the live product's code and documents (src/domain/liveProduct.ts).

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: SeedKey
fields.description: Seed key <workspaceId>:<scenario>:<key> of an example record, stamped by the server; unique index.

fields.name: SuccessTargets
fields.description: Success & performance of the version (JSON: outcome, users, responseTime, dataVolume, availability; each {value, unsure, choice, suggested, question}).

fields.name: ScreensReviewedAt
fields.description: When the version's screens were marked as reviewed (ISO time; empty = not reviewed).

fields.name: ScreensReviewedBy
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who marked the screens as reviewed.
